---
name: first-issue-pack
description: Create implementation-ready starter issues for VenturaSocial from the approved authorized-data MVP and Beta gates. Use when maintainers need small independent tasks that move the scaffold toward a reproducible prototype. Do not use when requirements are undefined or the issue would duplicate active work.
---

# First issue pack

- Read the current authorized-data scope and repository state first.
- Create one verifiable outcome per issue.
- Include provider terms privacy or retention acceptance criteria when relevant.
- Separate adapter analysis tests metrics and documentation work when independent.
- Keep each issue suitable for one focused pull request.
- Mark dependencies explicitly and exclude private-data collection or access-control bypass.
